newsitem.title: USA: CASH BRENT PEGGED AT 5-CT PREMIUM IN LATE US TRADE.
newsitem.headline: CASH BRENT PEGGED AT 5-CT PREMIUM IN LATE US TRADE.

text.p: Cash North Sea Brent was pegged at a five-cent premium to paper in late U.S. trading on Tuesday, traders said.
Three exchange-for-physical deals were transacted, two in September at $18.79 for 100 lots and $18.80 for 75 lots.
An October EFP changed hands at $18.88 a barrel for 100 lots.
September cash Brent was pegged at $18.83-18.85 a barrel, even with the close of London's IPE, traders said.
Two September/October spreads traded at minus nine cents a barrel, tighter than the day's earlier range of minus 13/11 cents.
October/November Brent was assessed at minus 14/11 cents, while November/December was valued at minus 13/11 cents.
